children: Overview
US renewable energy fund's interim net asset value was largely stable at $185.9 mln
Operational performance stabilized as asset remediation initiatives contributed to improvements
Company plans to declare a modest Q4 dividend, pending improved cash flow visibility
Outlook
Company expects further operational improvements by year-end as remediation plans are completed
US Solar Fund will consider declaring a modest Q4 dividend based on improved performance
Company continues to progress potential sale of its portfolio with extended exclusivity to a buyer
Result Drivers
ASSET REMEDIATION - Co said completion of capital investment initiatives at California assets and improved O&M practices drove operational performance improvements
SOLAR IRRADIANCE - Higher than forecast solar irradiance led to a 2.8% increase in performance
OUTAGE IMPACT - Significant outage at Milford asset led to 3% underperformance during the period; outage has been rectified
